paper_title: The Evolution of Darija Open Dataset Introducing Version 2
caption: Distribution of Content Types in the DODa
model_annotation: The donut chart illustrates the distribution of content types in the Darija Open Dataset (DODa) Version 2, showing six distinct categories with their respective numerical values. The largest segment, colored light green, represents "Pending Translations" with 43,000 entries. The second largest, in yellow, corresponds to "Translated Sentences" with 45,387 entries. The third largest, in blue, is labeled "Extra + Augmented Data" and contains 30,000 entries. A smaller orange segment indicates "Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)" with 23,108 entries. A very small purple slice denotes "Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)," and an even smaller red slice represents "Moroccan Names," though their exact values are not labeled on the chart. The chart includes a legend to the right, matching colors to categories, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top right. The chart uses a 3D effect and has a hollow center, with numerical values displayed directly on the corresponding slices for the larger categories.
